##### Project general facts

Address Branded Residences is a waterfront residential tower developed by ALAIN in partnership with Address Hotels + Resorts, bringing the brand's hospitality expertise to residential living. The slender tower is designed by the architecture studio Design Tomorrow, with a sculpted facade of curved balconies and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens the homes to views of the city skyline and the water. The residences comprise one- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses, planned to make the most of every space and suit different lifestyles.

The amenities are conceived at resort level and spread across the tower's shared spaces. Leisure facilities include an infinity pool, a children's pool and a rooftop pool deck with an outdoor bar, complemented by a sky garden. Wellness is covered by a fitness centre, a spa treatment room with a jacuzzi, a padel court and a running track. Residents also have a private cinema, a library, an owner's lounge, a co-working space and a multipurpose room, while families can use an indoor children's play area. Concierge and laundry services add hotel-style convenience to daily life.

Interiors are created by KCA International, a design practice known for luxury hospitality projects, with warm natural tones, soft textures and refined detailing throughout. Living and dining areas flow into open kitchens with marble surfaces, and generous terraces extend the living space outdoors. Master suites feature walk-in closets and spa-inspired bathrooms with freestanding bathtubs, while service and attentive management reflect the standards of the Address brand.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Maryah Island is the financial and business district of Abu Dhabi, home to Abu Dhabi Global Market and a skyline of office towers, hotels and residences set along the water. The Galleria mall anchors the island with luxury shopping, dining and entertainment, and an air-conditioned walkway links it directly to the surrounding towers. Al Maryah Promenade lines the waterfront with space for walks and outdoor time, with views towards Saadiyat Cultural District.

Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi is located on the island, and Cranleigh Abu Dhabi, New York University Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Beach Golf Club are within a short drive. Cultural landmarks such as the Louvre Abu Dhabi, the Guggenheim Museum Abu Dhabi and the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque are easily reached, as are the Corniche, Jubail Mangrove Walking Park and Yas Mall. Zayed International Airport serves international travel, and Dubai is connected by road.

Al Maryah Island is positioned as one of the most prestigious addresses in the capital, appealing to finance professionals, executives and families who value a central waterfront setting. The concentration of corporate offices, healthcare and retail supports steady rental demand from long-term tenants. Freehold ownership is available to international buyers, making the island an attractive option for investors seeking branded residential property in Abu Dhabi.
